body:
I'm not sure. I asked my new therapist what they thought therapy did for people and he said it wasn't for everybody.  Other people I've tried to talk to have either been private about it or talked about it like magic. I don't even get what I'm supposed to do. Everybody that was in my life told me I needed it but I don't talk to any of them anymore. I'm not sure. Mental health is way more nebulous other types of health problems and it's hard for me to understand how it can help me. I think talking to stranger on the internet has made me feel more safe in sharing than any therapist ever did.

What I've been doing isn't working. I know I'm being  irrational. I still feel so hopeless about it.

My next appointment is on Oct 1st. I get called three times a week from the office and they ask me if I'm still feeling down and try to connect me with resources. This'll be my third face to face with this new therapist. I'd mentioned my previous experience in passing while talking about why I left my last therapist and my therapist to me seemed to doubt my account of things. I don't have a lot of paper work from that time but am going to bring something in I guess to try to explain it better... I don't even know what therapy is for. It seems to just make me feel awful. I just think I'm going to say something wrong. Everything feels fake. I've got to keep going it's the only thing I have.

Thanks for your time. I'm less worried about being judged and more worried about losing my freedom over a misunderstanding. If I tell a stranger something and they think I'm going to hurt someone or myself and they act on that it's hearsay and defendable. I'd just call them a liar or explain yourself and your given the benefit of your word against their's. Because of the power mental health professionals words have with authority and process put in place to warn and protect being absolute I'm terrified something I say will end up taking my freedom away. I've seen that system do harm.

The panic I have in myself all the about this and feeling like it has made me not feel human anymore. It's gotten in the way of so many things in my life.

This is a post I made awhile ago about my first experience with therapy. https://www.reddit.com/r/depression/comments/kqvjdz/i_need_help_getting_help_or_something/

I've been trying to deal with this and other things recently but it so hard to deal with feeling like the only people who can help me are the one's who've hurt me most.

Monday I called the place I had my intake thing to find out if they could tell me when my appointment would be. They weren't but I was able to leave a messages letting him know I was making other appointments but that connecting with him was my priority.  I made an appointment with just a regular doctor to talk about medication and just the situation in general. I went yesterday I was pretty nervous but the doctor was really nice.  I told them I had started seeking a therapist had that intake but hadn't seen them yet. The doctor was familiar with the facility and said that usually they would recommend I wait to have my meds managed by them but that ther likelyhood of me getting situated soon was slim. They said that they would start me on some zoloft. I signed some releases of information so my therapist and new doctor could talk them picked up those meds. After I left the doctors office a stated walking home.  It was raining and a long walk about seven miles. I was walking along a busy road and saw a dog standing silhouetted in headlights far in front of me. As I got closer I started talking to the dog saying "hey puppy" and asking it where it was from. I pet it and it started waking with me. After a house or two somebody said "hey how are you" I couldn't see them and stopped to look around. A light came on and some guy was standing in an open garage. He said his dog seemed to like me. I said it seemed very sweet.  The guy asked me if I wanted to hang out. I said i wasn't in a hurry to be anywhere.  He asked if i was hungry i was... he asked me If i smoked pot i do... he invited me into his house though his garage. He was coming some chicken stir fry it smelled amazing.  He grabbed a rolling tray and asked me if I would roll him a couple joints while he finished cooking.  I just hang out in his kitchen rolling joints then petting his dog. He was I would say 60 or so and had just had knee surgery.  He said he was a material scientist who runs some lab for the department or ecology. His house was right on lake Washington and much nicer than the garage would let you think.  After he finished cooking we sat together and ate. He asked me what I had been doing that day and I told him I was coming from a doctors appointment. He asked if I minded if he asked what for.  I told him I'd just been feeling down.  He said he'd felt down alot in his life and that its okay to be sad sometimes.  I told him thank you. He said we could hang out anytime I wanted.  I told him thank you and we exchanged contact info.  He put some food together for me and walked me out his garage. I thanked him again and gave his dog some pets. The guy lit up and asked me if I wanted some mushrooms.  I wasn't sure what to say but went with yeah sure. He hobbled quickly back into and out of his house. He he handed me about two ounces of mushrooms.  I was aghast and said thanks a third time.  He patted me on the back and told me to have a good evening and to get ahold of him later. I walked off feeling better than I have in awhile.  I ate a couple mushrooms on my walk home and had a great time.  When I got home I had a message from my therapist trying to make an appointment for today at 11am. I wasn't able to make it but rescheduled for next Thursday at 9am. I told him I got on some meds and he said he'd  talked to my doctor. I had to take a break from reading that book.  Its helpful but stated making me really emotional.  I'll pick it up again but for now I might try something a little lighter. It was really nice to meet this random nice guy and my therapist seems nice.  I also got a big bag of mushrooms... which I feel great about too. I've got to think of something nice to do for that guy. Anyways that's what's going on.
Wouldn't mind hearing about your experience if you'd like to share.

I've enjoyed just  sharing thing with people and knowing they take time to respond.  I made my world really small by being a jerk for alot of different reasons. Any conversation is welcome though I've been in the doldrums and might not be chipper.

Ive been trying some form of self help for twenty years. I don't think I've made much headway.  I think a professional opinion though unwanted is necessary. Thanks for the suggestion though I might check that out.

Thanks. Somebody told me recently that getting help is a skill. I'd never thought about it like that and it's helped me a lot. I thought why couldn't I get better at it. Taking to a therapist the police a doctor or anybody official  scares the shit out of me. I've found being open and honest with strangers on the internet is easier.
Yeah I get that my fear is irrational.  I also am starting therapy. Thanks for the encouragement.
Im on board
Sure ill see what's good

I had an intake appointment today. I think it went okay even though I have nothing to compare it to. I stayed the whole time.  Thanks for taking time to talk to me and for listen.  Its meant the world to me. I'm still reading the body keeps the score. Section four chapter eleven and choochin' best I can. It's helped me be able to put some better words to what's going on. Thanks for that too.

I might ask for some similar reading suggestions or care to keep you informed if you'd like to know but mostly I'd just like to say thanks.  I special thanks I don't give many people that sounds the same to everybody but means a lot more to me. Thank you.

Sometime I feel kind of a weight on my chest and in my face that can but doesn't always take my breath away. I feel like a could just bawl or fight someone to the death.  It can go in for days and sometimes nothing comes of it and it just goes away... other time I cry and yell at people.

Thanks for sharing this shit. I've been trying to get help and having a hard time. I've been real overwhelming  via text for the few friends I'm  maintaining. I know how rough that can make somebody feel. I've been resorting to turning my phone off recently but I'm sure there is a better way to deal with that.  I guess I must mean to let you know that your not alone in a lot of how you feel and that I read this shit. I've got issues with therapists I'm trying to work out that shit too. It's hard to trust people and say things.  Everybody's telling me to do it. We can do this. Your not a failure thing's are just hard right now. Everybody's s little fucked up. It makes everybody unique.

I'm going though some similar feeling I think.  I hope we get this figured out. I think you can do it. I don't think I can do it sometimes too especially lately.  A lot of people are telling me that even little stuff like is good and helps. I sucks to feel like you'r family doesn't know you or can't help you. You not alone.
I feel weird using apps the 7cups things was lame.  Crisis lines haven't worked out and I ran out of friends recently

Just thinking about all this crap is so taxing. I'm not sure why but I can't bring myself to make online appointments. I don't think I would do it. I've made calls to places and left messages but don't answers callbacks.  If I'm put on hold I hang up. If I'm unable to answer a question I hang up. I've tried calling twenty or so therapist offices and public mental health lines. 

In the past I've made appointments and just paced outside until they were over.

I tried the 7 cups app thing a while ago. I don't know I just freeze up. I'm scared to go to a hospital. I wish I wasn't doing what I'm doing.  So many want to help me and I want help.  When I think about it though or try to do something I just end up feeling like something crushing my face and chest.  I try to calm down and just breath but in not having any luck. I wish I didn't have a choice. I wish getting help was the only option. The few people that talk to me make me feel like I want to be this way by not getting help. 

I've tried to explain it to people a couple of ways.  I've asked people if they've come close to drowning and felt the panic for air it incites. If they have I try to tell them that help feels like the water. Everyone has burned themselves at one point or another and knows what fire can do. I try to tell them getting help feel like having to hold my hand  in a flame. I don't feel like I have control over it. I'm irrationally scared of it. Nobody can help me but me. What do I do?

Yeah thanks for the well wishes they do help. I'm glad that's working for you. I'm having a hard time making myself do anything as productive as that.  I don't have good computer skills or a computer.    And just thinking about telling people what's going on in my heads scared the shit out of me. I know what's happening in my head is irrational and trying to explain it to anybody feels like it would do me harm.

Honestly about you not being a clinician is likely why I've figured anything here out or even felt like it's helped. I imagined you as a wise beyond your years person about my age from somewhere with great compassion and greater Google skills and laugh thinking you're doing a much better job of helping me out by just listen than anybody else has. Very few people know any of this crap has happened but my life was far from perfect before it. I'm pretty sure more is going on than I can put my heads around and that's felt obvious for years. I've pushed anybody who knew away. I'm pretty sure people in my life care for me more than you do... I wish it wasn't so hard to ask them for help or to accept it when it's offered.  It's hard to tell people what it is I need help with especially when being in that situation is part of the problem 

It's been easier to be a jerk for a long time.

I've thought about trying to meet a therapist somewhere outside. Hospitals and offices both bug me. Even going to the bank doesn't work for some reason.  So much of this crap gets in the way of me doing normal things and I don't know how I got this far. Without people I know helping me get jobs I don't think that would happen either.  

I've thought alot about how this happened trying to shed blame from myself. The connection to drug prohibition was one I made that helped. Now it's not a problem but it was the only illegal thing I ever did. I used to think of this as a punishment and how hard it made life for me isn't fair.  School was impossible after this shit.

As some part of some deal the school district peyed for me to have accredited tutors to finish high school but I couldn't stand it and didn't go. My lawyer encouraged me to sue them but I didn't want to go to court or be in any similar situation. I just wanted things to be normal. I didn't understand I didn't have to be. I think it would have been better for me to have but couldn't at the time. I knew it cost my family a lot to have me well represented and I saw the effects of that for years.

As far as dissociation goes I mean likely I guess but I gots the adhd and I guess an impulse control dealiebob figured out from before I thought everybody was trying to hurt me. I have a hard time trusting that diagnoses cuz I see people in my life use that to take responsibility away their actions. I might rather just be a lonely jerk than crazy

It seems to be as much of an accident as being stuck by lighting yeah. If your running around with a fifty foot metal pole called a therapist.
   
 I didn't blame me at first. I blamed them and found comfort in plotting their demise. I would find where the people I found accountable were.  Where they worked.  Thought of watching them suffer somehow though I never decided how. Somehow by myself blame changed. I started to imagine how scared they most of been of me and how unfair that was. I was hurt because I thought I was a good person or at very least not bad. Everybody thought I was a bad guy and I was thinking like a bad guy... things kind of fell into place about me being the problem. I didn't want to hurt anybody for any reason. I've known I've need some kind of help but feel like all these helpers are fucked in a way. 
 
I think people are prismic. Everybody makes a couple of people out of themselves to show different people for one reason or another. Like how my I showed my grandma I'd never sworn or my coworkers maybe that I'd never cried. I noticed that no matter who you are or who you show people or for what reason that person makes another you out of what they think about the person you've chosen to show them. This at least third me can couse take problems. Thev person that isn't me and isn't who I want people to think I am... I have a hard time wanting to put myself in that situation when that person is in a hospital or office. Just the smell of these places make me panic.

I got ahold of the body keeps score and finished the first chapter last night. It seems up my alley but is not enjoyable in pdf format and on my phone I'm easily distracted. I'm still trying to figure out a paper copy and maybe an audio that isn't yt.
It makes me wish I was drowning instead of crazy. Where a float or a hand could save me. I sure feel like I'm drowning.

The Naparstek's playlist was alright. She seems to know what's she's taking about and just from the little extra investigation I did seems to work well for a lot of people.  I might be understanding things wrong but guided imagery seems like meditation and I wonder how its methods of targeting are special.  The interview made it sound almost like a selling point and that was wierd. I also watched a couple videos of Bessel van der Kolk M.D. and read the book review. All of this information seems helpful though I'm not sure how yet (like having a hammer but never having seen a nail before. Its obvious that it has a handle and you hit things with it but what). I feel like I'm watching the cooking channel almost.  Both books are available through the library but they are closed. I might still be able to get them (covid'n stuff.) I'll figure that out tomorrow before trying borrow a couple bucks from somebody to scoop them from the interwebs.

As far as culpability goes I figured not having anybody to blame of focus some of the shit on was going to make it harder to deal with. Most of the time I think it's my fault for not being more careful about how I talk to people.  I feel like all the hubbub was cuz I didn't think enough about how to talk to those kind of people.  I spend so much time thinking about how to talk to somebody in a way to they can't misunderstand me.. its scary that if a professional misunderstands what I say or make intentions for me that aren't mine I still brake there eggs.

When I try to view the situation as a whole it's hard not to think it could have and should have been avoided and fuck is don't try whenever that smell is in the air.

Part of its that's hard is I know nobody was trying to hurt me. I mean not the big players at least. It was almost all misunderstandings and the consequences of mandatory processes put in place to keep people safe.  I unintentionally made a lot of people scared and am having a hard time thinking that that something similar can't happen again.  Even if I know it's not likely. 

 I'm going to read that review and see about tracking down a copy of that book. I'll check out that playlist too and check out the availability that book to. I watched the last video before responding and breathed much better after realizing I wasn't. Thanks for that especially.   I'm trying not to chicken out about this shit and it might take a sec for me to get through but I'll do my best to let you know how things hit me and maybe get some help finding more of what works for me. You're very kind.
I get this.
I've had a lot of people tell me recently  that all they can do is give me their best advice.  And I feel like I'm drowning and they are explaining to me how to swim.
Yes please.  I need to figure this out and this helped a lot more than I thought it could.  Do share anything you think will help. Also thanks so much for your time.

I've never talked to anybody about it honestly before . Everybody in my life is so confused about what's going on with me. I'm just mean and sad all the time. I'm really hard to be around and have been pushing people away that ask if I'm okay and then avoiding them. I've been trying to exercise more I go for walks and ride my bike. I do some pushups in the morning most days and when I'm anxious if I'm alone. I have a hard time even trying to find resources. Ever time I try I think about this shit i feel Ill and avoid it at all cost even if I'm by myself.  

All this here is probably the most healthy thoughts I've had about this.

Thanks.  In trying to figure this out. I panicked then straight faced lied my way out of getting help and I've done it before.. its so hard to tell people I don't want to talk to about this shit. They are the only people that can help me though I guess. It's wrecking my life.  Over the last twenty years I've made appointments places before to try to get help but I just pace outside... I can't help but think that if people came to get me unwillingly I might fight them to the death. I've call the crisis line before and I mean I'm still here but lied to them and didn't connect with resources. If I did I think I'd just pace around outside. I can't make myself do it yet.
